description: Update a custom field definition: rename the label, flip required, replace a select's options, or change a currency field's currencyCode. The TYPE is immutable by design — changing it would silently invalidate every stored value; archive and recreate in the app instead. Changing currencyCode RELABELS existing values (no conversion — the numbers stay as entered). Field ids come from get_item_requirements. Requires the manager role.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code (currency fields only), e.g. EUR or CHF — always name the code you want; the organization's default currency applies only when a field is created. Relabels existing values, never converts them.

name: update_field_def

currencyCode.description: ISO code of a currency field when it is not CHF (absent = CHF)

label.description: Field label as the org named it

type.description: Field type: text | number | date | select | multiselect | …

title: Update field definition
